title: Rclade: Automated Deep-Time Phylogenetic Tree Collapsing and Visualization
description: An R package for production-ready automated taxonomic collapsing and visualization of phylogenetic trees with geological timescales. Integrates taxonomic-label parsing, MRCA-based branch collapsing, monophyly checking, geological timescale visualization, in-depth input validation, and workflow-embeddable engineering conventions into a single function call.
